topic: ARIA-NBV Python standards and aria_nbv package guidance source-of-truth audit
rubric: Pass only if the research identifies all current Python/package guidance owners and redundancies, uses litkg or the repo KG where available to find additional candidate sources, compares against current external best-practice sources, explains why agents still reimplement existing aria_nbv functionality or violate Python standards, and produces a ranked streamlining plan with deprecation candidates, owner surfaces, verification gates, and residual risks.
critic_command: Review whether the result is evidence-backed, source-order aware, and actionable without creating new redundant Python guidance surfaces.
